metadata.name: NVIDIA RTX Remix Toolkit
metadata.description: Local MCP server built into the NVIDIA RTX Remix Toolkit, which exposes the Toolkit's REST API endpoints as MCP tools so AI agents can work with a running Toolkit. Listens on loopback only.

config.notes: The RTX Remix Toolkit must be running. 18014 is the preferred port; if it is occupied the Toolkit tries ports up to 18019 in order.
